title: Comprehensive Cognitive Assessment Test
description: A medically consistent IQ test based on modern CHC theory covering fluid reasoning, crystallized intelligence, visual-spatial processing, working memory, processing speed, and quantitative reasoning.

domains.Fluid Reasoning (Gf): Pattern recognition, logical reasoning, novel problem solving
domains.Visual-Spatial Processing (Gv): Visual patterns, spatial relationships, mental rotation
domains.Working Memory (Gwm): Memory span, mental manipulation, cognitive flexibility
domains.Processing Speed (Gs): Speed of cognitive processing, attention to detail

questions.question: Which number comes next in the sequence: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 3: 2×3=6, 6×3=18, 18×3=54, 54×3=162

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital city of Australia, not Sydney or Melbourne which are larger cities

questions.question: If you rotate a 'b' 180 degrees clockwise, what letter do you get?
questions.explanation: Rotating 'b' 180 degrees gives you 'q'

questions.question: Rearrange these letters to form a word: T-A-C-O-E-N
questions.explanation: T-A-C-O-E-N can be rearranged to spell CANOE

questions.question: If 3x + 7 = 22, what is the value of x?
All roses are flowers. Some flowers are red. Therefore:
questions.explanation: Since some flowers are red and all roses are flowers, some roses might be red

questions.question: Which word is most similar in meaning to 'ephemeral'?
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time, so temporary is the closest meaning

questions.question: Count the number of triangles in this description: 'Three overlapping triangles where each triangle shares one side with another'
questions.explanation: Three main triangles plus four smaller triangles formed by intersections = 7 total

questions.question: A penguin walks into a library and asks for fish. The librarian says 'This is a library!' The penguin whispers, 'Sorry... do you have any fish?' What logical fallacy is the penguin demonstrating?
questions.explanation: The penguin misunderstood what whispering in a library means vs. what a library actually provides

questions.question: If a pizza has 8 slices and you eat 3 slices, what fraction of the pizza remains?
questions.explanation: 8 - 3 = 5 slices remaining out of 8 total = 5/8

questions.question: A cat is stuck in a tree and keeps meowing 'Help!' If you view the tree from above and the cat is on the north side, which direction should the fire truck approach from to have the best angle?
questions.explanation: Approaching from the south gives the clearest access to the north side of the tree

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au is the chemical symbol for gold, from the Latin word 'aurum'

questions.question: A squirrel collects nuts in this order: acorn, walnut, pecan, acorn, walnut, pecan. If the pattern continues, what is the 10th nut?
questions.explanation: Pattern repeats every 3: positions 1,4,7,10 are acorns. The 10th nut is an acorn

questions.question: A duck walks into a pharmacy and asks for chapstick. When asked how he'll pay, he says 'Just put it on my bill.' How many words in this joke contain the letter 'i'?
questions.explanation: Words with 'i': into, chapstick, asked, he'll, it, bill = 6 words

questions.question: If all unicorns are magical and some magical creatures grant wishes, what can we conclude?
questions.explanation: Since unicorns are magical and some magical creatures grant wishes, some unicorns might grant wishes

questions.question: A hamster running on a wheel completes 50 rotations in 2 minutes. At this rate, how many rotations in 7 minutes?
questions.explanation: 50 rotations/2 minutes = 25 rotations/minute. 7 minutes × 25 = 175 rotations

questions.question: A cow sees a UFO and decides to investigate. If the cow is facing north and turns 90 degrees clockwise twice, which direction is it now facing?
questions.explanation: North → 90° clockwise → East → 90° clockwise → South

questions.question: Who wrote the novel '1984'?
questions.explanation: George Orwell wrote '1984', published in 1949

questions.question: A chicken tries to cross the road but gets distracted by corn kernels: 3, then 7, then 11. If this pattern continues, how many kernels at the 5th spot?
questions.explanation: Pattern increases by 4 each time: 3, 7, 11, 15, 19. The 5th spot has 19 kernels

questions.question: What comes next in this pattern: ○ ◐ ● ◑ ?
questions.explanation: The pattern shows moon phases in order, returning to full circle

questions.question: A sloth decides to race a cheetah but insists on a 24-hour head start. How many letters are in 'twenty-four hours'?
questions.explanation: Counting letters in 'twenty-four hours': t-w-e-n-t-y-f-o-u-r-h-o-u-r-s = 16 letters (including hyphen)

questions.question: What is 15% of 80?

A fish swimming in a rectangular aquarium sees itself in the mirror on the side wall. If the fish is at the center and the aquarium is 4 feet wide, how far does the fish appear to be from its reflection?
questions.explanation: The fish is 2 feet from the mirror, so its reflection appears 2 feet on the other side = 4 feet total distance

questions.question: What does the idiom 'barking up the wrong tree' mean?
questions.explanation: The idiom means pursuing the wrong course of action or making a false assumption

questions.question: A parrot learns words in this order: Hello, Goodbye, Please, Thank you, Sorry. If asked to repeat them backwards, what's the 3rd word?
questions.explanation: Backwards order: Sorry, Thank you, Please, Goodbye, Hello. The 3rd word is Please

questions.question: If A = 1, B = 2, C = 3... what does DOG equal?
A snail travels at 0.03 mph and needs to go 0.12 miles to reach lettuce. How long will it take?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance/Speed = 0.12/0.03 = 4 hours

questions.question: If you fold a square piece of paper in half, then in half again, how many layers thick is it now?
questions.explanation: Each fold doubles the thickness: 1 → 2 → 4 layers

questions.question: A bee buzzing around a garden visits flowers in alphabetical order. How many vowels are in 'chrysanthemum'?
questions.explanation: Vowels in 'chrysanthemum': y, a, e, u = 4 vowels

questions.question: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars is known as the Red Planet due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface

questions.question: A confused GPS tells you to turn left, right, left, right, left. If you started facing north, which direction are you facing now?
questions.explanation: North→left→West→right→North→left→West→right→North→left→West

questions.question: Which shape doesn't belong: Circle, Square, Triangle, Hexagon, Rectangle?
questions.explanation: Circle is the only shape without straight sides

questions.question: A pizza place offers a discount: Buy 2 pizzas at $12 each, get the 3rd for half price. What's the total for 3 pizzas?
A spider builds a web in the corner of a cube-shaped room. How many corners does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has 8 corners (vertices)

questions.question: A cat knocks over a glass of milk and it spills in the shape of the word 'CATASTROPHE'. How many letters contain curved lines?
questions.explanation: Letters with curves: C, A, T, A, S, T, R, O, P, H, E. Curved: C, A(2), S, O, P = 6

questions.question: What is the study of earthquakes called?
questions.explanation: Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes

questions.question: A monkey eating bananas follows this pattern: eat 1, throw 2, eat 1, throw 2. After 20 bananas, how many were eaten?
questions.explanation: Pattern: eat, throw, throw, eat, throw, throw... Every 3 bananas, 1 is eaten. 20÷3 = 6.67, so 6 complete cycles (6 eaten) + 2 remaining bananas (eat 1) = 7 eaten

questions.question: If some cats are dogs, and all dogs are animals, what must be true?
questions.explanation: If some cats are dogs, and all dogs are animals, then some cats must be animals
